newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Jade Technologies in Singapore IPO.
newsitem.headline: Jade Technologies in Singapore IPO.

text.p: Leadframe producer Jade Technologies Singapore Ltd said on Wednesday it was offering 8.0 million new shares at Singapore $0.75 each in its Singapore initial public offering.
Jade is a subsidiary of U.S. Industries Inc.
Jade said in a statement the offer comprised a placement tranche of 2.0 million shares and the remainder was being offered to the public.
Of the total issue, up to 2.0 million shares will be reserved for staff and business associates.
The shares are offered at a historical price earnings ratio of 9.7 times. The offer represents about 25 percent of the company's enlarged share capital.

Jade will raise net proceeds of about S$5.34 million to be used to finance the construction of its factory extention in Singapore, to partly fund the purchase of equipment for its photo-etching production line and for working capital.
For the financial year ended September 1996, Jade recorded a net profit of S$1.89 million on a turnover of S$24.95 million.
The share offer closes on January 27 and trading on a "when issued" basis will start on January 29 on the second board of the Singapore stock exchange.
